name: sayitlike
title: sayitlike
blurb: a free-text translator: type what you wrote and how you want it to come out — another language, 1990s skater slang, pirate, whatever — and it rewrites it that way. runs on your own OpenAI or OpenRouter key, entirely in your browser, with the system prompt and model fully editable. th.alassa.pink asked for a Kagi Translate clone.
